concepts.name: artificial intelligence tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor is a system designed to answer questions.

concepts.name: collection of course documents
concepts.definition: A collection of course documents is a set of educational materials.

concepts.name: questions about a collection of course documents
concepts.definition: Inquiries specifically concerning the content within a collection of course documents.

concepts.name: tutor
concepts.definition: An artificial intelligence tutor that answers questions about a collection of course documents.

concepts.name: language model
concepts.definition: A computational tool used by the tutor to generate explanations.

concepts.name: explanations
concepts.definition: Content generated by a language model for the tutor.

concepts.name: fluent wording
concepts.definition: The quality of being fluent in language, which does not guarantee factual accuracy.

concepts.name: factual accuracy
concepts.definition: The state of being factually correct.

concepts.name: training dataset
concepts.definition: The training dataset provides examples used to adjust the language model's parameters.

concepts.name: parameters
concepts.definition: Parameters are the components of the language model that are adjusted during training.

concepts.name: separate validation dataset
concepts.definition: A distinct collection of data used for evaluation purposes, separate from the training set.

concepts.name: model selection
concepts.definition: The process of choosing a specific model architecture or configuration based on performance metrics.

concepts.name: choice of training settings
concepts.definition: The decision regarding hyperparameters and configurations used during the model training phase.

concepts.name: held out test dataset
concepts.definition: A dataset reserved for evaluation after model selection and training settings are finalized.

concepts.name: performance
concepts.definition: The metric or outcome measured by the held-out test dataset following specific choices.

concepts.name: choices
concepts.definition: Decisions made regarding model selection and training settings, referenced as 'those choices' in the current context.

concepts.name: datasets

concepts.name: passages
concepts.definition: segments of text derived from a source

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: the process of teaching a model using data

concepts.name: testing
concepts.definition: the process of evaluating a model's performance

concepts.name: source
concepts.definition: the origin of the passages used in datasets

concepts.name: measured performance

concepts.name: unfamiliar material

concepts.definition: no specific target, applies to the datasets themselves

concepts.name: model ability

concepts.definition: The magnitude of the dataset.

concepts.definition: A specific type of neural network architecture used for processing text.

concepts.name: text
concepts.definition: The input data being processed by the model.

concepts.name: tokenizer
concepts.definition: A component that divides an input passage into tokens.

concepts.name: input passage
concepts.definition: The text data provided for processing.

concepts.name: token
concepts.definition: A unit resulting from dividing an input passage.

concepts.name: embedding layer
concepts.definition: A component that maps tokens to numerical vectors.

concepts.name: numerical vector
concepts.definition: The representation of a token in the embedding space.

concepts.name: positional information
concepts.definition: Information regarding the position of tokens within a sequence.

concepts.name: transformer
concepts.definition: A model architecture capable of processing sequences of tokens.

concepts.name: sequences containing the same tokens in different orders
concepts.definition: Ordered arrangements where the constituent tokens are identical but their arrangement varies.

concepts.name: attention layer
concepts.definition: A structural component within a transformer model that processes token representations.

concepts.name: self attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism operating within an attention layer to integrate data from token representations.

concepts.name: token representation
concepts.definition: The encoded form of a token used as input for processing within an attention layer.

concepts.name: information from token representations
concepts.definition: Data derived specifically from the encoded forms of tokens present in the input sequence.

concepts.name: causal attention mask
concepts.definition: A mechanism that restricts attention flow based on token order.

concepts.name: position
concepts.definition: A specific location in the sequence of tokens within a model's input.

concepts.name: attending to later positions
concepts.definition: The action of incorporating information from tokens that appear after the current one in the sequence.

concepts.name: model predicts the next token
concepts.definition: The operation where a language model generates an output based on previous context.

concepts.name: restriction
concepts.definition: A constraint or limitation imposed on a system's operation.

concepts.name: generation
concepts.definition: The phase where the model produces output tokens.

concepts.name: attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism that connects information across a passage.

concepts.name: information
concepts.definition: Data points or concepts linked by attention.

concepts.name: models finite context window
concepts.definition: A constraint limiting the amount of text available in a single request.

concepts.name: amount of text available
concepts.definition: The volume of input processed within one request, constrained by the context window.

concepts.name: attention weight
concepts.definition: A numerical value representing the strength of an attention connection.

concepts.name: associated claim
concepts.definition: The statement or proposition linked to a specific attention weight.

concepts.name: truth of associated claim
concepts.definition: The state where the associated claim is factually correct.

concepts.name: models predicted token probabilities
concepts.definition: Probabilities assigned to tokens by the model during operation.

concepts.name: next tokens in the training examples
concepts.definition: The subsequent tokens present within the provided training data instances.

concepts.name: loss function
concepts.definition: A mathematical construct used to quantify the discrepancy between predicted and actual values.

concepts.name: prediction error
concepts.definition: The difference between a model's output and the ground truth target.

concepts.name: backpropagation
concepts.definition: An algorithmic procedure for calculating gradients with respect to model parameters.

concepts.name: gradients
concepts.definition: Vector quantities representing the rate of change of a function, used to guide parameter updates.

concepts.name: optimizer
concepts.definition: An algorithm responsible for adjusting model parameters to minimize a loss function.

concepts.name: model parameters
concepts.definition: The adjustable variables within a machine learning model that define its behavior.

concepts.name: learning rate
concepts.definition: A hyperparameter that determines the magnitude of parameter adjustments during optimization.

concepts.name: size of updates
concepts.definition: The magnitude by which model parameters are adjusted in a single step.

concepts.name: training stability
concepts.definition: The state where training proceeds without instability.

concepts.name: improvement speed
concepts.definition: The rate at which model performance improves.

concepts.name: overfitting
concepts.definition: A state where improved training performance fails to translate into performance on unseen examples.

concepts.name: improved training performance
concepts.definition: Enhanced metrics during the training phase.

concepts.name: performance on unseen examples
concepts.definition: The ability to generalize to data not seen during training.

concepts.name: improved training performance fails to translate into performance on unseen examples
concepts.definition: The situation where gains in training metrics do not result in gains on test data.

concepts.name: dropout
concepts.definition: A regularization technique that randomly disables some activations during training.

concepts.name: ordinary inference
concepts.definition: Using the trained network without random disabling.

concepts.name: trained network
concepts.definition: The model after training, used for ordinary inference.

concepts.name: activations
concepts.definition: The active units or neurons in a neural network.

concepts.name: early stopping
concepts.definition: A training termination strategy based on validation performance.

concepts.name: validation performance
concepts.definition: The metric used to determine when training ends in early stopping.

concepts.name: held out test results
concepts.definition: Performance metrics from data not used for training or validation.

concepts.name: training end time
concepts.definition: The point at which the training process is terminated.

concepts.name: quantization

concepts.name: retrieval augmented generation
concepts.definition: A technique applied after training for specific purposes.

concepts.name: weight quantization
concepts.definition: A process that stores model parameters with fewer bits.

concepts.name: answer quality
concepts.definition: The standard of correctness in generated responses.

concepts.name: memory required to store model parameters
concepts.definition: The storage capacity needed for the model parameters.

concepts.name: aggressive reduction in precision
concepts.definition: A significant decrease in the number of bits used to represent model parameters.

concepts.definition: Text segments provided by the system to support tutoring responses.

concepts.name: question
concepts.definition: An inquiry posed to the tutor for which relevant passages are retrieved.

concepts.definition: A component that maps questions and document passages into embeddings.

concepts.name: document passages
concepts.definition: Segments of text from documents.

concepts.name: embeddings
concepts.definition: Vector representations derived from the question and document passages.

concepts.name: similarity search

concepts.name: index

concepts.name: selected passages

concepts.name: retrieval

concepts.name: models parameters
concepts.definition: The internal weights and configurations of the language model.

concepts.name: outdated

concepts.name: incorrect

concepts.definition: The process of assessing distinct aspects of a system's output.

concepts.name: quality of retrieval
